method.todoist: disposable 'ZZ probe rowonly' created via Quick Add (typed char-by-char with focus polled and asserted after each keystroke), measured via getBoundingClientRect on the real li row (title-only, no date/priority/label), two reads 200ms apart, then deleted via More actions -> Delete -> Enter, confirmed absent afterwards
method.meologue: seeded through taskStore.upsert() as 'ZZ probe rowonly' (priority default, date=null), reached via an in-app SPA click on the sidebar Inbox link, measured on the row box element inside li after document.getAnimations().forEach(a=>a.finish()), two reads 150ms apart

children.ariaLabel: Reorder or reparent "ZZ probe rowonly" — arrow keys to move, Alt+arrow keys to indent or outdent

verdict.note: Both apps now render a title-only row at exactly 43px, two identical reads each. Round 2 read meologue at 47px (row taller than its own 44px tallest child); round 1 read 59px (fixed minHeight floor). The row box's action buttons (44px each) are still taller than the 43px row itself in meologue -- they are laid out at opacity:0 until hover (ROW-12, a known deliberate divergence) and do not set the row's height floor.
